descriptionByLocale.en: ## Responsabilita - Perform preventive and corrective maintenance activities on F/A-18 and future military aircrafts - Carry out inspections, functional checks and testing in accordance with technical documentation - Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, hydraulic, electrical and avionics systems - Execute technical modifications and change orders - Participate in aircraft preparation and return-to-service activities - Ensure proper traceability of completed work and maintain maintenance documentation - Actively contribute to safety, quality and continuous improvement within maintenance operations ## • Requisiti - Completed vocational training in a (electro-)technical field (i.e. Polymechanic, Automation technician, Electromechanical technician or comparable) - Strong interest in aviation and complex technical systems - Good (technical) Englishskills a prerequisite (or strong motivation to improve this competence) - Good command of either French or German; knowledge of a second national language is considered as plus - Category B driving licence - Reliable, precise and team-oriented personality with a strong sense of responsibility - Swiss citizenship (due to military/air force related function) Optional but highly advantegous: previous aviatic and/or military jet related experiences( i.e. EASA Part-66 modules, B1/B2 licenses, SAP or other IT-management systems) ## Contatto Judith Sattler Talent Acquisition Specialist +41 58 461 76 37
descriptionByLocale.de: ## Reaktionsfähigkeit - Führen Sie präventive und korrektive Wartungsaktivitäten an F / A-18 und zukünftigen Militärflugzeugen durch - Durchführung von Inspektionen, Funktionsprüfungen und Prüfungen gemäß den technischen Unterlagen - Diagnose und Fehlersuche mechanische, hydraulische, elektrische und Avioniksysteme - Führen Sie technische Änderungen und Änderungsaufträge aus - Teilnahme an Tätigkeiten zur Vorbereitung und Rückkehr von Luftfahrzeugen - Gewährleistung der ordnungsgemäßen Rückverfolgbarkeit abgeschlossener Arbeiten und Pflege der Instandhaltungsunterlagen - Aktiv zur Sicherheit, Qualität und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung im Instandhaltungsbetrieb beitragen ## • Requisiti - Absolvierte Berufsausbildung in einem (elektro-)technischen Bereich (d.h. Polymechaniker, Automatisierungstechniker, Elektromechaniker oder vergleichbar) - Starkes Interesse an Luftfahrt und komplexen technischen Systemen - Gutes (technisches) EnglischSkills eine Voraussetzung (oder starke Motivation, diese Kompetenz zu verbessern) - Gute Beherrschung von Französisch oder Deutsch; Kenntnisse einer zweiten Landessprache gelten als plus - Führerschein der Klasse B - Zuverlässige, präzise und teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit starkem Verantwortungsbewusstsein - Schweizer Staatsbürgerschaft (aufgrund militärischer/luftwaffenbezogener Funktionen) Optional, aber sehr vorteilhaft: frühere Erfahrungen mit Luftfahrt- und/oder Militärjets (z. B. EASA-Teil-66-Module, B1/B2-Lizenzen, SAP- oder andere IT-Managementsysteme) ## Contatto Judith Sattler Talent Acquisition Spezialist +41 58 461 76 37
descriptionByLocale.fr: ## Responsabilitéa - Effectuer des activités de maintenance préventive et corrective sur F/A-18 et les futurs aéronefs militaires - Effectuer des inspections, des contrôles fonctionnels et des essais conformément à la documentation technique - Systèmes de diagnostic et de dépannage mécaniques, hydrauliques, électriques et avioniques - Exécuter des modifications techniques et des ordres de modification - Participer à la préparation des aéronefs et aux activités de retour en service - Assurer une traçabilité adéquate des travaux achevés et maintenir la documentation d'entretien - Contribuer activement à la sécurité, à la qualité et à l'amélioration continue des opérations de maintenance ## • Requisiti - Achevé une formation professionnelle dans un domaine (électrotechnique) (polymécanique, technicien d'automatisation, technicien électromécanique ou comparable) - Intérêt pour l'aviation et les systèmes techniques complexes - Bonne (technique) compétences anglaises une condition préalable (ou une forte motivation pour améliorer cette compétence) - Bonne maîtrise du français ou de l'allemand; connaissance d'une deuxième langue nationale est considérée comme plus - Permis de conduire de catégorie B - Personnalité fiable, précise et axée sur l'équipe, avec un fort sens des responsabilités - Citoyenneté suisse (en raison de la fonction militaire ou aérienne) Facultatif mais hautement advantégous: expériences antérieures liées aux jets aviatiques et/ou militaires (c'est-à-dire modules de la partie 66 de l'AESA, licences B1/B2, SAP ou autres systèmes de gestion informatique) ## Contatto Judith Sattler Spécialiste en acquisition de talents +41 58 461 76 37

descriptionByLocale.en: Application Engineer Real Estate (m/f/d) 60-100% | SBB - - - - - - Move Switzerland with us. Application Engineer Department Real Estate (m/f/d) Bern and Zurich / Work Smart, from now on or by agreement, 60-100% Apply now ## You can look forward to it. In the ImmoConnect team, you develop customer-oriented real estate solutions from SBB using modern web technologies and assume responsibility in an environment based on the Scaled Agile Framework. You design digital touchpoints around SBB real estate and provide seamless experiences for customers. In an agile product team, you work closely with marketing, real estate management, product owners, digital services and external partners. You’ll work in a BizDevOps organization where business, development and operations work hand in hand to ensure that stable solutions deliver value quickly. You develop technically and professionally, deepen your knowledge in modern web frameworks and interface architectures and take on responsibility in program enhancement planning and agile rituals in the SAFe context. Benefits such as free GA, discounted travel abroad - also for the family - can be found on our website under Benefits. You can move that. As part of an agile team, you translate the requirements of the marketing and real estate management departments into viable software solutions and thus make a direct contribution to customer-friendly touchpoints around SBB real estate. You will advise specialists as a competent contact person on technical solution options and coordinate approaches and priorities with product owners and product architects. - Web developments you independently supervise and realize with modern technologies from analysis to implementation to operation. Define system requirements, analyze change requests and incidents, implement and test applications and interfaces, and ensure quality with reviews and automated tests. In a BizDevOps organization, you work closely with internal and external partners and ensure smooth transfers between development and operations. You bring that with you. - Working independently is central to you and shapes your actions, you set priorities, make independent decisions and perform tasks reliably until completion. - You bring several years of experience in web development and you work with HTML5, JavaScript or TypeScript and frameworks like Angular and PHP and ideally with a CMS like WordPress. - With interfaces and API design such as OData and REST as well as API management you are familiar and have a basic understanding of SAP ERP modules. - You bring a higher education FH/HF/uni in computer science and act customer-focused and solution-oriented in an agile environment. - In German you communicate safely at level C1 and in English at least at level B2. ## Your wages and benefits. We have a fair and progressive wage system and are actively committed to equal pay. Therefore, further and detailed information on the wage system is transparently visible at SBB. This position is in requirement level J, regional allowance level 1. ## This is the starting point. The fact that you want to move Switzerland with us is the greatest motivation for us. Therefore, we refrain from a letter of motivation at this point. If you still want to tell us your motivation, you still have the opportunity to do so in our application tool. Making big is easier with you. descriptionByLocale.it: Fedeli alla visione "Guidiamo l'innovazione per migliorare la vita delle persone", le aziende Hamilton forniscono soluzioni per il settore sanitario dal 1950. Siamo pionieri innovativi quando si tratta di ventilatori, pipettaggio e conservazione automatizzati di campioni e sviluppo di sensori di processo. La business unit Process Analytics sviluppa, produce e vende tecnologie di misurazione di processo all'avanguardia per clienti del settore biofarmaceutico, chimico e dei birrifici. Il nostro portafoglio di prodotti comprende sensori per parametri di processo critici come valore pH, ossigeno o sensori per la misurazione della densità cellulare, che sono estremamente importanti nei processi biologici e unici al mondo con la loro tecnologia innovativa. Questo è ciò che puoi ottenere: Supporto tecnico all'organizzazione commerciale e ai clienti. L’obiettivo è costruire e garantire una fidelizzazione sostenibile dei clienti, con particolare attenzione alla garanzia e all’espansione del potenziale di vendita. Ciò include anche il riconoscimento e la valutazione delle tendenze del mercato e la presentazione dei risultati rilevanti alla gestione del prodotto per la revisione e il follow-up. Compiti principali È la persona di contatto per i clienti e l'organizzazione di vendita per la corretta integrazione dei nostri prodotti nel processo del cliente, per domande relative all'applicazione e semplici richieste tecniche. Pianifica ed esegue dimostrazioni/presentazioni di prodotti come test eseguiti in modo indipendente ai clienti in consultazione con il responsabile delle vendite. Fornisce un feedback sui risultati delle posizioni di prova e delle visite dei clienti al responsabile delle vendite responsabile e archivia la documentazione trasparente a livello centrale. Contribuisce, ove necessario e utile, con i risultati dei test, delle visite ai clienti, delle tendenze del mercato, ecc., in modo costruttivo e indipendente alla gestione del prodotto. Compiti aggiuntivi È corresponsabile della risposta tempestiva e del coordinamento delle e-mail e delle chiamate in arrivo dei clienti. Ciò include anche la creazione e l'elaborazione di casi e RMA nel sistema di gestione dei reclami (ServiceNow CSM). Garantisce una valutazione orientata al cliente e allo stesso tempo economica dei reclami dei clienti e delle relative soluzioni sostenibili e soddisfacenti per il cliente. Ove necessario, vengono coinvolti i colleghi del team di supporto tecnico e/o del supporto di assistenza sul campo. Organizzazione interdisciplinare di seminari per i clienti, webinar di formazione e istruzione per i clienti, nonché organizzazione di assistenza e vendita, e partecipazione attiva ove necessario. Rappresenta i colleghi dell'Application Support Team in loro assenza. Le attività descritte comportano molti viaggi. Cosa porti con te: Formazione completata e preferibilmente ulteriori studi nel campo della chimica o biochimica a livello HF, TS, Bachelor, Master o simili. Idealmente, diversi anni di esperienza professionale nell'ambiente industriale dell'industria di processo, idealmente nell'industria chimica, farmaceutica o alimentare
descriptionByLocale.en: True to the vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives", the Hamilton companies have been providing solutions for the healthcare industry since 1950. We are an innovative pioneer when it comes to ventilators, automated pipetting and storage of samples, and the development of process sensors. The Process Analytics business unit develops, produces and sells state-of-the-art process measurement technology for customers in biopharma, chemicals and breweries. Our product portfolio includes sensors for critical process parameters such as pH value, oxygen, or sensors for measuring cell density, which are extremely important in biological processes and unique worldwide with their innovative technology. This is what you can achieve: Technical support for the sales organization and customers. The goal is to build and ensure sustainable customer loyalty, with a focus on securing and expanding sales potential. This also includes recognizing and evaluating market trends and bringing relevant findings to product management for review and follow-up. Main tasks Is the contact person for the customers and sales organization for the successful integration of our products in the customer process, for application-related questions and simple technical inquiries. Plans and carries out product demonstrations/presentations such as test runs independently to customers in consultation with the responsible sales manager. Gives feedback on the findings of the test positions and customer visits to the responsible sales manager and stores transparent documentation centrally. Contributes the findings from testing, customer visits, trends in the market, etc., where necessary and useful, constructively and independently to product management. Additional tasks Is jointly responsible for the timely response and coordination of incoming customer emails and calls. This also includes creating and processing cases and RMAs in the complaints management system (ServiceNow CSM). Ensures a customer-oriented and at the same time economical assessment of customer complaints and the associated satisfactory sustainable solutions to the customer. Where necessary, colleagues from the Technical Support Team and/or Field Service Support are involved. Interdisciplinary organization of customer seminars, webinar training and education for customers as well as service and sales organization, and actively participates where necessary. Represents the colleagues from the Application Support Team in their absence. The activities described involve a lot of travel. What you bring with you: Completed training and preferably further studies in the field of chemistry or biochemistry at the level of HF, TS, Bachelor, Master or similar. Ideally, several years of professional experience in the industrial environment of the process industry, ideally in the chemical, pharmaceutical or food industries
descriptionByLocale.de: Getreu der Vision "We drive innovation to improve people's lives" liefern die Hamilton Unternehmen seit 1950 Lösungen für die Gesundheitsbranche. Unser Produktportfolio umfasst Sensoren für kritische Prozessparameter wie den pH-Wert, Sauerstoff, oder auch Sensoren zur Messung der Zelldichte, wie sie in biologischen Prozessen enorm wichtig und mit ihrer innovativen Technologie weltweit einzigartig sind. Hauptaufgaben Ist Ansprechpartner für die Kunden und Verkaufsorganisation zur erfolgreichen Integration unserer Produkte im Kundenprozess, bei applikativen Fragestellungen sowie einfachen technischen Anfragen. Bringt die Erkenntnisse der Teststellungen, Kundenbesuche, Trends im Markt usw., wo nötig und sinnvoll, konstruktiv wie auch selbständig beim Produktmanagement ein. descriptionByLocale.fr: Fidèles à la vision « Nous encourageons l'innovation pour améliorer la vie des gens », les sociétés de Hamilton fournissent des solutions au secteur de la santé depuis 1950. Notre gamme de produits comprend des capteurs pour les paramètres de processus critiques tels que la valeur du pH, l'oxygène ou des capteurs pour mesurer la densité cellulaire, qui sont extrêmement importants dans les processus biologiques et uniques au monde grâce à leur technologie innovante. L’objectif est de fidéliser et d’assurer une fidélité durable des clients, en mettant l’accent sur la sécurisation et l’expansion du potentiel de vente. Cela inclut également la reconnaissance et l'évaluation des tendances du marché et la transmission des conclusions pertinentes à la gestion des produits pour examen et suivi. Assure une évaluation à la fois orientée client et économique des réclamations des clients et des solutions durables satisfaisantes associées pour le client. Si nécessaire, des collègues de l’équipe d’assistance technique et/ou du service d’assistance sur site sont impliqués. Organisation interdisciplinaire de séminaires clients, de formations et d'éducation par webinaires pour les clients ainsi que de l'organisation du service et des ventes, et participation active si nécessaire. Représente les collègues de l’équipe de support applicatif en leur absence. Les activités décrites impliquent beaucoup de déplacements. Ce que vous apportez : Une formation terminée et de préférence des études complémentaires dans le domaine de la chimie ou de la biochimie au niveau HF, TS, Bachelor, Master ou similaire. Idéalement, plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans le milieu industriel de l'industrie de transformation, idéalement dans les industries chimiques, pharmaceutiques ou agroalimentaires

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Il ruolo di Assistente Manager Food Beverage è soddisfacentemente quando: - Tutte le regole e le norme sono fissa e rispettate all'interno dell'hotel, comprese le norme di sicurezza e igiene, compreso HACCP. - Le vendite sono spinte al loro massimo potenziale negli outlet specifici assegnati dal Capo Dipartimento Food Beverage. - Tutti i costi sono in linea con le vendite senza pari la qualità, cioè con un punteggio minimo del 85%. - Il dipartimento o gli outlet assegnati sono capaci in modo imprenditoriale, cercando possibilità per generare più affari. - L'innovazione e le nuove idee sono promosse, implementate e sicure con altri hotel attraverso l'ufficio centrale. - L'impiegato è pronto ad assumere la posizione di Capo Dipartimento Food Beverage presso l'Hotel Kempinski Palace Engelberg. Mansioni - Sostenere e implementare nuove iniziative di sviluppo del talento. - Identificare raccontonti interni esterni che servono ai valori DNA di Kempinski. - Sostenere la crescita del talento per presentare candidati nelle chiamate di trasferimento del talento trimestrali. - Incontrare tutti i nuovi dipendenti Food Beverage. - Sostenere il Capo Dipartimento Food Beverage nella conduzione delle competenze di prestazione annuale e fornire ai dipendenti regolari feedback sul loro rendimento lavorativo. Requisiti - Eseguire un esempio di comportamento, presentandosi in orario e vestendo abbigliamento aziendale secondo il codice di abbigliamento dell'hotel e i standard di cura personale di Kempinski. - Fornire un servizio professionale e cortese in tutte le occasioni e assicurarsi che tutti gli impiegati seguano l'esempio. - Essere a conoscenza di tutti i servizi e i prodotti offerti dall'hotel. - Avere una conoscenza approfondita e comprensione di tutti i prodotti e servizi alimentari e di bevande. - Gestire le operazioni degli outlet assegnati dal Capo Dipartimento Food Beverage. - Assistere nella preparazione e consolidamento del bilancio annuale per il dipartimento. - Assistere nella preparazione dello stato di flusso dei ricavi mensili per ogni uscita e per il suo complesso, partecipare alla riunione mensile di prestazione con la gestione degli outlet. - Gestire il magazzino consolidato del dipartimento Food Beverage. - Partecipare e contribuire attivamente a tutte le riunioni di personale fondamentale e alle formazioni dell'hotel. - Condurre riunioni di briefing giornaliero con il Cuoooco Esecutivo in assenza del Capo Dipartimento Food Beverage. - Partecipare o subire (in assenza del Capo Dipartimento Food Beverage) riunioni quotidiane o settimanali di Food Beverage. - Revisionare e aggiornare annualmente i manuali di operazioni del dipartimento. - Assistere nella ricerca dei migliori prodotti disponibili. Cosa? - Opportunità di carriera e sviluppo professionale. - Ambiente di lavoro dinamico e imprenditoriale. - Possibilità di lavorare in un hotel di lusso con una forte identità e valori. Contatto - Per ulteriori informazioni, contattare il nostro ufficio di personale.

descriptionByLocale.it: Nel settore delle imposte aziendali, non si tratta solo di sostenere le aziende nel rispetto delle normative. Si consiglia inoltre alle imprese nazionali o internazionali in materia di regolamenti e sviluppi fiscali pertinenti. Possono costruire strutture efficienti, tenere conto delle implicazioni fiscali di possibili modelli di business ed evitare rischi fiscali. In qualità di membro del team prezioso, si consiglia ai clienti: in varie questioni fiscali (sia aziende che individui) e partecipare alla gestione di progetti impegnativi. • consigliare le persone giuridiche di varie industrie e industrie in materia fiscale. • Accompagna la pianificazione fiscale delle aziende dei nostri clienti nazionali e internazionali: internamente e calcola le disposizioni fiscali necessarie per fornire i migliori risultati possibili. • Modificare richieste fiscali complesse e complesse in un ambiente internazionale e utilizzare la vostra esperienza per trovare le migliori soluzioni possibili. • Lavori su progetti esigenti e spesso transfrontalieri nei settori della ristrutturazione aziendale, dell'acquisizione e della vendita. Porta il tuo know-how per contribuire con successo al successo del progetto. • Utilizzare lo scambio promettente all'interno del reparto fiscale e legale per sviluppare sia personalmente che professionalmente rapidamente. • Lavorare in un team ispiratore e completare una formazione professionale per il idg. dipl. Esperto fiscale. Usa la tua conoscenza imparata per ottenere risultati ideali. • Completamento presso un'università o un college, idealmente in scienze economiche o giuridiche. • Interessi in materia fiscale e hanno già acquisito la prima esperienza nel settore delle imposte/tasse aziendali. • Porta il tuo fascino a domande legali, nonché figure e relazioni commerciali e goditi di lavorare all'interfaccia di legge ed economia. • Sii flessibile, duraturo e aperto a situazioni difficili e complesse e apprezzi la collaborazione del team. Usa le tue abilità individuali per ottenere i migliori risultati. • Interesse a domande interdisciplinari e scambio con il nostro cliente: dentro. • Mostra la sicurezza di stile in tedesco e hanno ottime competenze in inglese per agire con successo in un ambiente internazionale.
descriptionByLocale.en: In the field of corporate taxes, it is not just about supporting companies in compliance with regulations. We also advise national or international companies with regard to the relevant tax regulations and developments. They can build efficient structures, take account of the tax implications of possible business models and avoid tax risks. As a valuable team member, you advise customers: in various tax matters (both companies and individuals) and participate in managing challenging projects. • advise legal persons from various industries and industries in tax matters. • Accompany the tax planning of companies of our national and international customers: internally and calculate the required tax provisions to deliver the best possible results. • Edit challenging and complex tax enquiries in an international environment and use your expertise to find the best possible solutions. • Work on demanding, often cross-border projects in the areas of corporate restructuring, acquisition and sale. Bring your know-how to contribute successfully to the success of the project. • Use the promising exchange within the tax and legal department to develop you both personally and professionally quickly. • Work in an inspiring team and complete a professional training for the idg. dipl. Tax expert. Use your learned knowledge to achieve ideal results. • Completion at a university or college, ideally in economic or legal sciences. • Interest in tax issues and have already gained initial experience in the field of corporate taxes/taxes. • Bring your flair to legal questions as well as figures and business relationships and enjoy working at the interface of law and economics. • Be flexible, enduring and open to challenging and complex situations and appreciate the team's collaboration. Use your individual skills to achieve best results. • Interest in interdisciplinary questions and exchange with our client: inside. • Show style security in German and have very good English skills to successfully act in an international environment.
descriptionByLocale.de: Im Bereich Unternehmenssteuern geht es nicht nur darum, Unternehmen bei der Einhaltung von Vorschriften zu unterstützen. descriptionByLocale.it: Nel tuo ruolo di professionista esperto nel dipartimento Audit – Commercio, Industrie e Servizi di PwC, fai parte di un team in cui contano la tua esperienza e la tua prospettiva. Attribuiamo grande importanza alla diversità e ti supportiamo nel raggiungimento dei tuoi obiettivi professionali, nello sviluppo ulteriore delle tue capacità e nell'affrontare nuove sfide. Contribuirai a plasmare l'economia di domani: digitale, sostenibile e globale. Eseguite la revisione dei bilanci annuali e consolidati di enti e società nazionali e internazionali del settore industriale, commerciale e dei servizi. Controllerai i processi aziendali e fornirai assistenza per domande sulla contabilità secondo diversi standard (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP). Lavorerai con l'Engagement Manager alla pianificazione, implementazione e finalizzazione di vari ordini di test, nonché di vari test speciali e sarai in contatto diretto con altri specialisti. Farai parte della rivoluzione digitale nell'auditing utilizzando e contribuendo a migliorare i nostri strumenti e approcci all'auditing digitale. Acquisire una conoscenza approfondita di un'ampia gamma di clienti e costruire e mantenere relazioni con i clienti ti attrae. Ti supporteremo nel tuo sviluppo professionale e personale attraverso coaching on e off-the-job per raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi di carriera a lungo termine. Come parte di un team stimolante e diversificato, farai parte di una rete internazionale e riceverai feedback regolari da colleghi e superiori. Stai completando o hai appena completato la formazione per diventare un auditor qualificato. Hai almeno due anni di esperienza professionale nella revisione contabile e hai acquisito conoscenze sugli audit aziendali delle aziende. Hai forti capacità analitiche, elevati standard di qualità per te stesso e per il team e vorresti promuovere attivamente la digitalizzazione nell'auditing. Sei motivato e aiuti a progettare soluzioni per superare le richieste dei nostri clienti. Sei pronto ad assumerti responsabilità fin dall'inizio e a lavorare in un ambiente con una cultura del coaching attiva. Hai ottime competenze scritte e parlate in tedesco e inglese.
descriptionByLocale.en: In your role as an experienced professional in the Audit – Trade, Industries & Services department at PwC, you are part of a team where your experience and perspective count. We attach great importance to diversity and support you in achieving your professional goals, further developing your skills and mastering new challenges. You will help shape the economy of tomorrow – digital, sustainable and global. You audit annual and consolidated financial statements for national and international corporations and companies from the industrial, commercial and service sectors. You will check business processes and provide assistance with questions about accounting according to various standards (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP). You will work with the Engagement Manager on the planning, implementation and finalization of various test orders as well as various special tests and will be in direct contact with other specialists. You will be part of the digital revolution in auditing by using and helping to improve our digital auditing tools and approaches. Acquiring in-depth knowledge of a wide range of customers and building and maintaining customer relationships appeal to you. We will support you in your professional and personal development through on- and off-the-job coaching to achieve your long-term career goals. As part of an inspiring, diversified team, you will be in an international network and receive regular feedback from colleagues and superiors. You are completing or have just completed training to become a qualified auditor. You have at least two years of professional experience in auditing and have gained insights into business audits of companies. You have strong analytical skills, high quality standards for yourself and the team and would like to actively promote digitalization in auditing. You are motivated and help design solutions to exceed the demands of our customers. You are ready to take on responsibility right from the start and work in an environment with an active coaching culture. You have very good written and spoken German and English skills.
descriptionByLocale.de: In deiner Rolle als erfahrener Profi im Bereich Audit – Trade, Industries & Services bei PwC bist du Teil eines Teams, bei dem deine Erfahrung und Perspektive zählt. Wir legen großen Wert auf Vielfalt und unterstützen dich dabei, deine beruflichen Ziele zu erreichen, deine Kompetenzen weiter auszubauen und neue Herausforderungen zu meistern. Du gestaltest die Wirtschaft von morgen mit – digital, nachhaltig und global. Du prüfst Jahres- und Konzernrechnungen bei nationalen und internationalen Konzernen und Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Industrie, Handel und dem Dienstleistungssektor. Geschäftsprozesse werden von dir geprüft und du leistest Hilfestellung bei Fragen zur Rechnungslegung nach verschiedenen Standards (OR, IFRS, Swiss GAAP FER, US GAAP). Du bist Teil der digitalen Revolution der Wirtschaftsprüfung, indem du unsere digitalen Prüftools und -ansätze einsetzt und mithilfst, sie zu verbessern. Du wirst von uns in deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung durch On- und Off-the-Job-Coaching unterstützt, um deine langfristigen Karriereziele zu erreichen. Als Teil eines inspirierenden, diversifizierten Team befindest du dich in einem internationalen Netzwerk und erhältst regelmässig Feedback von Kolleg:innen und Vorgesetzten. Du absolvierst die Ausbildung zum/zur Dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in oder hast diese soeben abgeschlossen. Du bringst mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung mit und hast dabei Einblicke in betriebswirtschaftliche Prüfungen von Unternehmen gewonnen. Du hast ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch an dich und das Team und möchtest aktiv die Digitalisierung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung vorantreiben. Du bist motiviert und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Ansprüche unserer Kund:innen zu übertreffen. Du bist bereit, von Anfang an Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich in einem Umfeld mit einer aktiven Coachingkultur zu bewegen. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

descriptionByLocale.it: Vieni ad AXA, la società di assicurazione leader in Svizzera - come Per rafforzare il nostro team di successo per la zona di Lucerne, stiamo cercando una personalità orientata al cliente e negoziante con un sacco di impegno. Per i partecipanti laterali e i professionisti con una connessione locale, offriamo l'introduzione perfetta con opportunità di formazione e sviluppo di prima classe. In qualità di leader assicuratore svizzero, offriamo ambiziose persone interessanti opportunità di carriera e leeway imprenditoriale. Dedicazione appassionata ai clienti e AXA - Consulenza individuale e orientata alla soluzione (fisica o digitale) da parte dei clienti assicurativi: - Mantenere e ampliare le relazioni con i clienti esistenti - Mediazione di altri prodotti (assistenza finanziaria e preventiva, servizi sanitari) di AXA Acquisizione di nuovi clienti (utilizzando strumenti moderni e digitali e processi interni esistenti AXA) - Apprendistato completo e esperienza professionale nel settore dei servizi o idealmente nel settore assicurativo - I professionisti e gli operatori laterali con un certificato corrispondente di prestazione sono benvenuti - L'ancoraggio nella regione è vantaggioso - Aspetto convincente e buona capacità di articolazione - personalità vincente e resiliente combinata con un elevato orientamento al cliente e al servizio - Alto livello di indipendenza e flessibilità - Conoscenza di stile-confidente del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura, altre lingue sono vantaggiose Utensili digitali moderni e contemporanei Il nostro processo di applicazione Venite a conoscere il nostro processo di domanda e ottenere risposte a domande che i candidati spesso ci fanno. Se avete bisogno di supporto durante il processo di applicazione, basta mettersi in contatto. I colleghi del reclutamento sono felici di aiutarvi. Diversità e inclusione Diversità, pari opportunità e inclusione sono importanti per noi in AXA. La nostra cultura aziendale promuove rispetto e apertura in modo che ogni persona possa sviluppare il proprio pieno potenziale con noi. Per questa posizione, non possiamo considerare le domande di assunzione.
descriptionByLocale.en: Come to AXA, the leading insurance company in Switzerland - as To strengthen our successful team for the Lucerne area, we are looking for a customer-oriented and negotiating personality with a lot of commitment. For lateral entrants and professionals with a local connection, we offer the perfect introduction with first-class training and development opportunities. As a leading Swiss insurer, we offer ambitious people attractive career opportunities and entrepreneurial leeway. Passionate dedication to customers and AXA - Solution-oriented and personal all-round advice (physical or digital) from insurance customers: - Maintaining and expanding existing customer relationships - Mediation of other products (financial and preventive care, health services) of AXA Acquisition of new customers (using modern and digital tools and existing internal AXA processes) - Completed apprenticeship and professional experience in the service sector or ideally in the insurance industry - Professionals and lateral entrants with a corresponding certificate of performance are welcome - Anchoring in the region is beneficial - Convincing appearance and good articulation ability - Winning and resilient personality combined with a high customer and service orientation - High level of independence and flexibility - Style-confident knowledge of German in words and writing, other languages are advantageous Enjoying modern and contemporary digital tools Our application process Get to know our application process and get answers to questions that applicants often ask us. If you need support during the application process, just get in touch. The colleagues from recruiting are happy to help you. Diversity and Inclusion Diversity, equal opportunities and inclusion are important to us at AXA. Our corporate culture promotes respect and openness so that every person can develop their full potential with us. For this position, we cannot consider applications for recruitment.

descriptionByLocale.it: Fincons Group è una società di consulenza aziendale informatica che da 40 anni progetta il futuro digitale di aziende leader sui mercati internazionali. Fincons Group ha costruito la propria reputazione prevedendo e interpretando nuovi modelli di business e la rapida evoluzione dei sistemi IT costruendo una gamma completa di servizi: dalla ricerca e consulenza alla progettazione e sviluppo, dall'integrazione di sistemi di soluzioni software dei principali fornitori fino alla gestione delle applicazioni, supportando i clienti passo dopo passo nel loro percorso di trasformazione digitale. Fincons è una multinazionale con oltre 2.600 persone e diverse sedi nel mondo (in Italia, Svizzera, Germania, Francia, Regno Unito, Belgio e USA), ma soprattutto un'azienda familiare dove i fondatori svolgono un ruolo strategico con impegno e passione, radicando l'azienda sugli stessi principi di una famiglia unita e premurosa. Crediamo fermamente nel valore della cooperazione e nel contributo che ogni idea e intuizione può portare. Crediamo che lo sforzo di tutti possa fare la differenza. Trasformare la conoscenza in una risorsa strategica è la nostra missione aziendale, e la perseguiamo con l'ausilio del nostro asset più strategico: le nostre persone. Cerchiamo sviluppatori senior full-stack con una forte focalizzazione su Angular (front-end) ed esperienza in .NET/# (back-end) per partecipare a tempo pieno a progetti internazionali con sede a Lugano. Ruoli e responsabilità - Progettare e implementare soluzioni software di alta qualità sull'intero stack, con particolare attenzione allo sviluppo Angular - Sviluppare servizi backend robusti e scalabili utilizzando C# e .NET - Applicare best practice come TDD, DDD, Clean Code e principi SOLID - Collaborare a stretto contatto con architetti e responsabili tecnici per definire soluzioni tecniche e infrastrutture ottimali - Garantire standard di consegna elevati con forte attenzione alle pipeline CI/CD e ai test automatizzati - Assumere la proprietà delle prestazioni, dell'affidabilità e della scalabilità delle applicazioni - Analizzare i requisiti aziendali e proporre in modo proattivo soluzioni tecniche in linea con gli obiettivi del cliente Qualifiche e competenze - Laurea scientifica (laurea o master), preferibilmente in informatica o ingegneria - Almeno 5 anni di esperienza come ingegnere software full stack - Forte competenza in Angular (ultime versioni) e TypeScript - Solida esperienza con C# e .NET (Core / .NET 6+) - Buona conoscenza dell'architettura frontend, gestione dello stato e integrazione API - Esperienza pratica con TDD, Clean Code e principi SOLID - Esperienza di lavoro con database relazionali (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL o DB2) e forte conoscenza di SQL - Familiarità con le pipeline CI/CD e le moderne pratiche DevOps - Italiano e inglese fluenti (sia parlato che scritto) Flessibilità di localizzazione e lavoro - Si prega di notare che per questo ruolo non è offerta una politica di lavoro completamente remoto - I candidati devono essere pronti a trasferirsi nel Canton Ticino (Svizzera) o nelle aree di confine italiane vicine alla Svizzera - Giorni di lavoro da casa potrebbero essere possibili in base alla politica del cliente La nostra ricerca di personale è rivolto a candidati di ogni genere. I dati saranno trattati e conservati esclusivamente per le finalità di questa o di future selezioni, nel rispetto della Legge Federale sulla Protezione dei Dati (LPD) e garantendo i diritti di cui all'art. 13 D.Lgs 196/03 e regolamento UE 679/2016 (GDPR).
descriptionByLocale.en:
Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family.

We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people.

We are looking for Senior Full-Stack Developers with a strong focus on Angular (Front-End) and experience in .NET/ # (Back-End) to be part on full-time mode of international projects based in Lugano .

Roles and Responsibilities

- Design and implement high-quality software solutions across the full stack, with primary focus on Angular development
- Develop robust and scalable backend services using C# and .NET
- Apply best practices such as TDD, DDD, Clean Code, and SOLID principles
- Collaborate closely with architects and technical leads to define optimal technical solutions and infrastructure
- Ensure high delivery standards with strong attention to CI/CD pipelines and automated testing
- Take ownership of the performance, reliability, and scalability of applications
- Analyze business requirements and proactively propose technical solutions aligned with client objectives

Qualifications and Skills

- Scientific degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s), preferably in Computer Science or Engineering
- At least 5 years of experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer
- Strong expertise in Angular (latest versions) and TypeScript
- Solid experience with C# and .NET (Core / .NET 6+)
- Good understanding of frontend architecture, state management and API integration
- Hands-on experience with TDD, Clean Code and SOLID principles
- Experience working with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL or DB2) and strong SQL knowledge
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices
- Fluent Italian and English (both spoken and written)

Location and Work Flexibility

- Please note that a fully remote work policy is not offered for this role
- Candidates should be prepared to relocate to Canton Ticino (Switzerland) or to Italian border areas close to Switzerland
- Work-from-home days may be possible according to the Client's policy

Our personnel search is addressed to candidates of all genders. The data will be processed and stored exclusively for the purposes of this or future selections, in compliance with the Federal Data Protection Law (LPD) and guaranteeing the rights referred to in art. 13 Legislative Decree 196/03 and EU regulation 679/2016 (GDPR).
descriptionByLocale.de: Die Fincons Group ist ein IT-Business-Beratungsunternehmen, das seit 40 Jahren die digitale Zukunft führender Unternehmen auf internationalen Märkten gestaltet. Die Fincons Group baute ihren Ruf auf der Vorhersage und Interpretation neuer Geschäftsmodelle und der schnellen Entwicklung von IT-Systemen auf, indem sie ein komplettes Dienstleistungsspektrum aufbaute: von Forschung und Beratung über Design und Entwicklung, von der Systemintegration führender Anbieter von Softwarelösungen bis hin zum Anwendungsmanagement und unterstützt Kunden Schritt für Schritt auf ihrem Weg zur digitalen Transformation. Fincons ist ein multinationales Unternehmen mit über 2.600 Mitarbeitern und mehreren Niederlassungen weltweit (in Italien, der Schweiz, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, Belgien und den USA), aber vor allem ein Familienunternehmen, in dem die Gründer mit Engagement und Leidenschaft eine strategische Rolle spielen und das Unternehmen auf den gleichen Prinzipien einer vereinten und fürsorglichen Familie gründen. Wir glauben fest an den Wert der Zusammenarbeit und an den Beitrag, den jede Idee und Intuition leisten kann. Wir glauben, dass der Einsatz jedes Einzelnen einen Unterschied machen kann. Wissen in eine strategische Ressource umzuwandeln, ist unsere Unternehmensmission, und wir verfolgen sie mit Hilfe unseres strategischsten Kapitals: unseren Mitarbeitern. Wir suchen Senior Full-Stack-Entwickler mit einem starken Fokus auf Angular (Front-End) und Erfahrung in .NET/# (Back-End), um in Vollzeit an internationalen Projekten mit Sitz in Lugano teilzunehmen. Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – Entwerfen und implementieren Sie hochwertige Softwarelösungen im gesamten Stack, mit Schwerpunkt auf der Angular-Entwicklung – Entwickeln Sie robuste und skalierbare Backend-Dienste mit C# und .NET – Wenden Sie Best Practices wie TDD, DDD, Clean Code und SOLID-Prinzipien an – Arbeiten Sie eng mit Architekten und technischen Leitern zusammen, um optimale technische Lösungen und Infrastruktur zu definieren – Sorgen Sie für hohe Bereitstellungsstandards mit starker Aufmerksamkeit für CI/CD-Pipelines und automatisierte Tests – Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Skalierbarkeit von Anwendungen - Analysieren Sie Geschäftsanforderungen und schlagen Sie proaktiv technische Lösungen vor, die auf die Ziele des Kunden abgestimmt sind. Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten - Wissenschaftlicher Abschluss (Bachelor oder Master), vorzugsweise in Informatik oder Ingenieurwesen - Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als Full-Stack-Software-Ingenieur - Starke Fachkenntnisse in Angular (neueste Versionen) und TypeScript - Solide Erfahrung mit C# und .NET (Core / .NET 6+) - Gutes Verständnis der Frontend-Architektur, Zustandsverwaltung und API-Integration - Praktische Erfahrung mit TDD, Clean Code und SOLIDE Grundsätze – Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit relationalen Datenbanken (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL oder DB2) und fundierte SQL-Kenntnisse – Vertrautheit mit CI/CD-Pipelines und modernen DevOps-Praktiken – Fließendes Italienisch und Englisch (in Wort und Schrift) Standort- und Arbeitsflexibilität – Bitte beachten Sie, dass für diese Rolle keine vollständige Remote-Arbeitsrichtlinie angeboten wird – Kandidaten sollten bereit sein, in den Kanton Tessin (Schweiz) oder in italienische Grenzgebiete in der Nähe der Schweiz umzuziehen – Tage, an denen Sie von zu Hause aus arbeiten können möglich gemäß den Richtlinien des Kunden. Unsere Personalsuche richtet sich an Kandidaten aller Geschlechter. Die Daten werden ausschließlich für die Zwecke dieser oder zukünftiger Auswahlen unter Einhaltung des Bundesdatenschutzgesetzes (BDSG) und unter Gewährleistung der in Art. 1 genannten Rechte verarbeitet und gespeichert. 13 Gesetzesdekret 196/03 und EU-Verordnung 679/2016 (DSGVO).

descriptionByLocale.it: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

descriptionByLocale.de: Beschreibung Unter einem Namen, der sich auf die Tradition bezieht, ist Kempinski seit 1897 Hotelier. Die geräumigen Resorts und die stilvollen Stadt- und Wellnesshotels spiegeln einen individuellen und einzigartigen Charakter wider, insbesondere für Gäste, die 5-Sterne-Service und Luxus auf ihren Geschäfts- oder Privatreisen schätzen. Die griechische Küche ist eine der ältesten und vielfältigsten der Welt. Mit Neora bringt das Grand Hotel des Bains Kempinski diese kulinarische Tradition auf ein neues Niveau: modern interpretiert und mit kosmopolitischem Flair. Die Gäste können eine sinnliche Erfahrung erwarten, die authentische Ursprünge mit warmer Gastfreundschaft kombiniert. Von handgeformtem Pita-Brot und kaltem gepresstem Olivenöl bis hin zu Souvlaki, das über einem offenen Feuer zubereitet wird – jeder Teller ist ein Tribut an die Ursprünge der griechischen Küche und ist dazu gedacht, geteilt zu werden. Möchtest du dich mit hohen Standards messen? Bist du nur zufrieden, wenn deine Gäste es sind? Bist du hoch motiviert und schätzt die Expertise eines gut koordinierten Teams? Um unser innovatives Food-Beverage-Team zu stärken, suchen wir eine motivierte und dynamische Persönlichkeit, um als Host/Hostess Commis de Rang in unserem Restaurant Neora von der kommenden Sommer-Saison 2026 beitreten zu können. ## Aufgaben - Begrüßen unsere Gäste und sie zu ihrem Tisch begleiten - Tische reservieren - Unseren verschiedenen Restaurant-Optionen aktiv fördern - Die Service-Team unterstützen - Wenn nötig, das Operations-Team unterstützen, insbesondere während Spitzenzeiten oder Events ## Anforderungen - Dein Motto ist es, ein perfekter und freundlicher Gastgeber für jeden Kunden zu sein, während du unsere F&B-Outlets aktiv fördern. - Für diese herausfordernde Rolle hast du: - Ein Hotel-Training abgeschlossen und erste Berufserfahrung in der Luxusgastronomie gesammelt. - Neben deiner makellosen Haltung und deiner gepflegten Erscheinung beeindruckst du mit deinem natürlichen Charme. - Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Kenntnisse der menschlichen Natur - Eine strukturierte und organisierte Arbeitsweise - Ein lebendiges Interesse an Teamarbeit - Sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Italienisch, Englisch und Deutsch sind ein Prärequis - Verkaufsfähigkeit und Überzeugungskraft ## Was wir bieten - Leben und Arbeiten im Herzen der Engadiner Alpen - Accueillir nos clients et les accompagner à leur table - Réserver les tables - Faire la promotion active de nos différentes options de restauration - Soutenir l'équipe de service - Soutenir le département des opérations lorsque nécessaire, en particulier pendant les périodes de pointe ou les événements ## Exigences - Votre devise est d'être un hôte parfait et aimable pour chaque client tout en faisant la promotion active de nos F&B outlets. - Pour ce rôle exigeant, vous avez : - Terminé un cours de formation en un hôtel comparable et avez une expérience professionnelle initiale en gastronomie de luxe. - En plus de votre tenue impeccable et de votre apparence soignée, vous impressionnez par votre charme naturel. - Bonnes compétences en communication et connaissance de la nature humaine - Une approche structurée et organisée du travail - Une large gamme d'opportunités pour façonner votre carrière - Un environnement de travail agréable dans une équipe jeune et dynamique - Possibilités de carrière internationales et d'opportunités de développement - Avantages pour les employés exceptionnels dans tous les hôtels Kempinski, notamment : - Logement pour les employés à proximité de l'hôtel, y compris des services de lavanderie, une salle de sport et une salle commune, une cuisine et une large gamme de plats dans notre restaurant pour employés - Utilisation gratuite du centre de soins pour les enfants des employés - Activités mensuelles pour les employés, comme des cours de ski, de snowboard et de cross-country, des randonnées, des soirees de spa et des cours de français - Comité interne "Feel Good" pour aider à façonner toutes les questions de bien-être ## Contact (Insert contact information)

descriptionByLocale.it: Du bist Teil eines Teams, das nicht nur Zahlen prüft, sondern Zusammenhänge erkennt. Jedes Projekt ist einzigartig und bietet dir die Chance, zu wachsen und einen Unterschied zu machen. Vielfalt ist unsere Stärke. Solltest du dir noch unsicher sein, wie der Alltag in der Wirtschaftsprüfung aussieht, dann probiere unsere Virtual Case Experience aus. In 3-4 Stunden kannst du reale betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen lösen und einen Einblick in die Praxis gewinnen. Bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit, deine Skills und dein Wille, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen. Was du ausserdem mitbringen solltest: Einen bevorstehenden oder abgeschlossenen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, STEM oder einer anderen Studienrichtung. Begeisterung für Zahlen, digitale Trends und Nachhaltigkeit. Den Wunsch, in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Kulturen zusammenzuarbeiten. Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch. Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen mit frischen Ideen zu lösen. Deine Perspektive - Mehr als nur ein Job Wir wissen, dass der Start ins Berufsleben aufregend, aber auch herausfordernd sein kann. Deshalb begleiten wir dich auf deinem Weg - mit einem klaren Plan und starker Unterstützung:Zeitliche und finanzielle Förderung: Wir unterstützen dich umfassend bei deiner Weiterbildung zur/zum dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in. Du erhältst nicht nur finanzielle Unterstützung, sondern auch die Flexibilität, deine Lernzeit optimal zu gestalten. Flexibilität, die zu dir passt: Unsere Arbeitszeitmodelle geben dir die Freiheit, Beruf, Lernen und Freizeit in Einklang zu bringen. Mentoring und Entwicklung: Du wirst von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen begleitet, die dich fördern und inspirieren. Ein Team, das dich stärkt: Bei uns findest du eine Gemeinschaft, die Vielfalt schätzt, Ideen feiert und dich ermutigt, über dich hinauszuwachsen. Warum PwC? Weil wir wissen, was dir wichtig ist. Sinnvolle Arbeit, die einen Unterschied macht. Ein Team, das dich inspiriert. Und die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft aktiv mitzugestalten. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Community of Solvers. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung - digital, nachhaltig und global.
descriptionByLocale.en: Description You are part of a team that not only checks numbers but also recognizes connections. At PwC in the Audit - Financial Services (Banking) department, you analyze companies: How successful are they? Where are the opportunities and risks? How can they become more sustainable? Here, you work with curious and ambitious people to shape the economy of tomorrow - digital, sustainable, and global. Every project is unique and offers you the chance to grow and make a difference. Diversity is our strength. Your perspective counts, and we support you in achieving your goals. Do you want more than just a job; you want to make an impact? Welcome to PwC! Here, you can: - Understand and transform companies: Audit consolidated and annual financial statements and ensure they meet regulatory requirements - on site, in the office, or flexibly from home. - Shape the digital future: Use state-of-the-art tools, AI, and data analysis to take auditing to a new level. Your ideas count! - Drive sustainability: Support the audit of ESG reports and accompany companies on their path to greater environmental awareness and social responsibility. - Build networks: Work with leadership teams and CFOs and establish contacts that will shape your career. - Take responsibility: Develop your leadership skills in an international team that promotes and inspires you. Especially during the intense busy season from January to Easter, you make a decisive contribution to the success of our clients. ## Requirements If you're still unsure what everyday life in auditing looks like, try our Virtual Case Experience. In 3-4 hours, you can solve real business-related questions and get an insight into practice. For us, your personality, skills, and willingness to make the world a bit better count. In addition to this, you should: - Have an upcoming or completed Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Computer Science (Business), STEM, or another field of study. - Be enthusiastic about numbers, digital trends, and sustainability. - Desire to work in an international environment and collaborate with people from different cultures. - Strong communication in German and English. - Team spirit and the ability to solve challenges with fresh ideas. ## What we offer Your perspective - More than just a job We know that starting your working life can be exciting but also challenging. That's why we accompany you on your journey - with a clear plan and strong support: - Time and financial support: We comprehensively support you in your training as a certified auditor. You receive not only financial support but also the flexibility to optimally design your learning time. - Flexibility that suits you: Our working time models give you the freedom to balance work, learning, and leisure. - Mentoring and development: You will be accompanied by experienced colleagues who promote and inspire you. - A team that strengthens you: Here, you find a community that appreciates diversity, celebrates ideas, and encourages you to grow beyond yourself. ## Contact Apply now and become part of our Community of Solvers. Together, we design the future of auditing - digital, sustainable, and global.

In 3-4 Stunden kannst du reale betriebswirtschaftliche Fragestellungen lösen und einen Einblick in die Praxis gewinnen. Bei uns zählen deine Persönlichkeit, deine Skills und dein Wille, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen. Was du ausserdem mitbringen solltest: - Einen bevorstehenden oder abgeschlossenen Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, STEM oder einer anderen Studienrichtung. - Begeisterung für Zahlen, digitale Trends und Nachhaltigkeit. - Den Wunsch, in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten und mit Menschen aus verschiedenen Kulturen zusammenzuarbeiten. - Kommunikationsstark in Deutsch und Englisch. - Teamgeist und die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen mit frischen Ideen zu lösen. ## Cosa offriamo Deine Perspektive - Mehr als nur ein Job Wir wissen, dass der Start ins Berufsleben aufregend, aber auch herausfordernd sein kann. Deshalb begleiten wir dich auf deinem Weg - mit einem klaren Plan und starker Unterstützung: - Zeitliche und finanzielle Förderung: Wir unterstützen dich umfassend bei deiner Weiterbildung zur/zum dipl. Wirtschaftsprüfer:in. Du erhältst nicht nur finanzielle Unterstützung, sondern auch die Flexibilität, deine Lernzeit optimal zu gestalten. - Flexibilität, die zu dir passt: Unsere Arbeitszeitmodelle geben dir die Freiheit, Beruf, Lernen und Freizeit in Einklang zu bringen. - Mentoring und Entwicklung: Du wirst von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen begleitet, die dich fördern und inspirieren. - Ein Team, das dich stärkt: Bei uns findest du eine Gemeinschaft, die Vielfalt schätzt, Ideen feiert und dich ermutigt, über dich hinauszuwachsen. ## Contatto Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Community of Solvers. Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Zukunft der Wirtschaftsprüfung - digital, nachhaltig und global.

Chez PwC, dans le département Audit - Services financiers (banques), vous analysez les entreprises : combien sont-elles efficaces ? Où se trouvent les opportunités et les risques ? Comment peuvent-elles devenir plus durables ? Ici, vous travaillez avec des personnes curieuses et ambitieuses pour façonner l'économie de demain - numérique, durable et mondiale. Chaque projet est unique et vous offre la chance de grandir et de faire une différence. La diversité est notre force. Votre perspective compte et nous vous soutenons pour atteindre vos objectifs. Ici, vous pouvez : - Comprendre et transformer les entreprises : auditez les états financiers consolidés et annuels et assurez-vous qu'ils répondent aux exigences réglementaires - sur site, au bureau ou de manière flexible depuis la maison. - Façonner l'avenir numérique : utilisez des outils à l'état de l'art, l'IA et l'analyse de données pour porter l'audit à un nouveau niveau. Vos idées comptent ! - Promouvoir la durabilité : soutenez l'audit des rapports ESG et accompagnez les entreprises sur leur chemin vers une plus grande conscience environnementale et une responsabilité sociale. - Construire des réseaux : travaillez avec des équipes de direction et des directeurs financiers et établissez des contacts qui façonneront votre carrière. - Assumer des responsabilités : développez vos compétences de leadership dans une équipe internationale qui vous soutient et vous inspire. Surtout pendant la saison intense de travail de janvier à Pâques, vous contribuez de manière décisive au succès de nos clients. ## Exigences Si vous êtes encore incertain sur ce que la vie quotidienne en audit ressemble, essayez notre expérience de cas virtuel. En 3-4 heures, vous pouvez résoudre des questions commerciales réelles et obtenir un aperçu de la pratique. Pour nous, votre personnalité, vos compétences et votre volonté de rendre le monde un peu meilleur comptent. En outre, vous devriez : - Avoir un diplôme de bachelor ou de master imminent ou complété en économie, informatique (économie), STEM ou un autre domaine d'étude. - Être enthousiaste pour les chiffres, les tendances numériques et la durabilité. - Désirer travailler dans un environnement international et collaborer avec des personnes de cultures différentes. - Communication solide en allemand et en anglais. - Esprit d'équipe et capacité à résoudre des défis avec des idées fraîches. ## Ce que nous offrons Votre perspective - Plus qu'un emploi Nous savons que commencer votre vie professionnelle peut être excitant mais aussi difficile. C'est pourquoi nous vous accompagnons dans votre parcours - avec un plan clair et un soutien solide : - Soutien temporel et financier : nous vous soutenons de manière globale dans votre formation en tant qu'auditeur certifié. Vous recevez non seulement un soutien financier mais également la flexibilité pour concevoir de manière optimale votre temps d'apprentissage. - Flexibilité qui vous convient : nos modèles de temps de travail vous donnent la liberté de concilier travail, apprentissage et loisirs. - Mentorat et développement : vous serez accompagné par des collègues expérimentés qui vous soutiennent et vous inspirent. - Une équipe qui vous renforce : ici, vous trouverez une communauté qui apprécie la diversité, célèbre les idées et vous encourage à grandir au-delà de vous-même. ## Contact Postulez maintenant et devenez partie de notre Communauté de Solvers. Ensemble, nous concevons l'avenir de l'audit - numérique, durable et mondial.

descriptionByLocale.it: #Innovation and Technology #Permanent Position #International Mind-set #Challenging Projects Fincons Group è una società di consulenza IT che da 40 anni progetta il futuro digitale delle aziende leader sui mercati internazionali. Fincons Group ha costruito la sua reputazione nel prevedere e interpretare nuovi modelli di business e la rapida evoluzione dei sistemi IT costruendo una gamma completa di servizi: dalla ricerca e dalla consulenza alla progettazione e allo sviluppo, dall'integrazione di sistemi di soluzioni software leader nel settore fino alla gestione delle applicazioni, supportando i clienti passo dopo passo lungo il loro percorso di trasformazione digitale. Fincons è una multinazionale con oltre 2.600 persone e diversi uffici in tutto il mondo (in Italia, Svizzera, Germania, Francia, Regno Unito, Belgio e Stati Uniti), ma soprattutto una Società Famiglia dove i fondatori giocano un ruolo strategico con impegno e passione, fondando l'azienda negli stessi principi di una famiglia unita e premurosa. Crediamo fermamente nel valore della cooperazione e nel contributo che ogni idea e intuito possono portare. Crediamo che lo sforzo di tutti possa fare la differenza. Trasformare la conoscenza in una risorsa strategica è la nostra missione aziendale, e lo perseguiamo con l'aiuto del nostro asset più strategico: la nostra gente Siamo alla ricerca di un esperto e motivato Test Automation Engineer per garantire la qualità, le prestazioni e l'affidabilità dei nostri prodotti software. Si tratta di un ruolo di leadership pratico, che combina l'eccellenza tecnica nell'automazione dei test con la responsabilità di guidare le attività di test e le migliori pratiche in tutto il team. In questo ruolo, si progetta, sviluppa e manterrà test automatizzati backend scritti in Java , con una forte attenzione ai test API robusti. Potrai anche fungere da punto di riferimento per la strategia di qualità e test, collaborando a stretto contatto con sviluppatori e stakeholder per integrare le pratiche di test nel ciclo di vita di sviluppo e migliorare continuamente la copertura e l'efficienza dei test. Principali responsabilità - Agire come Test Lead per attività di backend e test API, fornendo assistenza tecnica e direzione, rimanendo completamente hands-on - Progettare, implementare e mantenere script di test automatizzati basati su Java per i sistemi backend, con una forte enfasi sul test API - Definire ed evolvere la strategia globale di automazione dei test, i quadri e le migliori pratiche - Contribuire alla copertura di test di automazione dei sistemi frontend quando necessario - Tradurre i requisiti tecnici e aziendali in scenari di test efficaci e riutilizzabili - Eseguire casi di test automatizzati, analizzare i risultati e segnalare i difetti in modo tempestivo e dettagliato - Indagare e risolvere guasti e problemi durante le prove - Assicurare l'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità dei test automatizzati all'interno delle condotte CI/CD - Coordinare le attività di test, privilegiare gli sforzi di test e sostenere il miglioramento continuo dei processi di test - Definire e implementare standard di controllo della qualità e contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo - descriptionByLocale.en: #Innovation and Technology #Permanent Position #International Mind-set #Challenging Projects Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all, a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family. We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Test Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, performance, and reliability of our software products. This is a hands‑on leadership role , combining technical excellence in test automation with responsibility for guiding testing activities and best practices across the team. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain backend automated tests written in Java , with a strong focus on robust API testing. You will also act as a reference point for quality and testing strategy, collaborating closely with developers and stakeholders to integrate testing practices into the development lifecycle and continuously enhance test coverage and efficiency. Key • Responsibilities - Act as Test Lead for backend and API testing activities, providing technical guidance and direction while remaining fully hands‑on - Design, implement, and maintain Java‑based automated test scripts for backend systems, with a strong emphasis on API testing - Define and evolve the overall test automation strategy, frameworks, and best practices - Contribute to test automation coverage of frontend systems when needed - Translate technical and business requirements into effective and reusable test scenarios - Execute automated test cases, analyze results, and report defects in a timely and detailed manner - Investigate and troubleshoot failures and issues during test runs - Ensure seamless integration of automated tests within CI/CD pipelines - Coordinate testing activities, prioritize test efforts, and support continuous improvement of testing processes - Define and implement quality control standards and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives - Collaborate with the development team to understand application workflows and develop comprehensive test strategies - Mentor and support team members on test automation topics when required ## Required • Qualifications and Skills - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience - 5+ years of hands‑on experience in backend test automation, with a proven track record in API testing - Previous experience in a Test Lead, Senior Test Automation Engineer, or similar role is highly valued - In-depth experience with tools such as Postman, SoapUI, JMeter - Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, including test design, automation, validation, and troubleshooting - Practical experience using SQL for data verification and test setup - Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) - Experience with Jira and Xray for test management - Excellent command of Italian and English (spoken and written) - ISTQB Certification or similar is a plus - Hands-on experience with tools such as Tosca Tricentis in a plus - Solid understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Scrum teams - Strong ownership mindset, proactive attitude, and willingness to actively contribute to day‑to‑day testing activities ## Location Requirement - Please note that a fully remote work policy is not offered for this role - Candidates should be prepared to relocate to Canton Ticino/Switzerland or towns near the Swiss-Italian border - Work-from-home days may be possible according to the Client's policy Do not hesitate and apply now! descriptionByLocale.fr: #Innovation et technologie #Position permanente #Projets internationaux Fincons Group est une société de conseil en informatique qui conçoit l'avenir numérique des grandes entreprises sur les marchés internationaux depuis 40 ans. Fincons Group a bâti sa réputation sur la prévision et l'interprétation de nouveaux modèles d'affaires et sur l'évolution rapide des systèmes informatiques en construisant une gamme complète de services : de la recherche et du conseil à la conception et au développement, de l'intégration de systèmes de solutions logicielles de premier plan jusqu'à la gestion des applications, en soutenant les clients étape par étape dans leur parcours de transformation numérique. Fincons est une multinationale avec plus de 2 600 personnes et plusieurs bureaux dans le monde entier (en Italie, en Suisse, en Allemagne, en France, au Royaume-Uni, en Belgique et aux États-Unis), mais surtout une société familiale où les fondateurs jouent un rôle stratégique avec engagement et passion, ancrer l'entreprise dans les mêmes principes d'une famille unie et bienveillante. Nous croyons fermement à la valeur de la coopération et à la contribution que chaque idée et intuition peuvent apporter. Nous croyons que tout le monde peut faire la différence. Transformer le savoir en ressource stratégique est notre mission d'entreprise, et nous la poursuivons avec l'aide de notre atout le plus stratégique : notre personnel Nous recherchons un ingénieur d'automatisation de test hautement qualifié et motivé pour assurer la qualité, les performances et la fiabilité de nos produits logiciels. Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership pratique, combinant l'excellence technique en matière d'automatisation des essais et la responsabilité de guider les activités d'essais et les pratiques exemplaires dans l'ensemble de l'équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous concevez, développez et maintenez des tests automatisés backend écrits en Java, avec un accent fort sur les tests d'API robustes. Vous agirez également comme point de référence pour la stratégie de qualité et de test, en collaborant étroitement avec les développeurs et les intervenants pour intégrer les pratiques de test dans le cycle de développement et améliorer continuellement la couverture et l'efficacité des tests. Principales responsabilités - Agir en tant que plomb d'essai pour les activités d'essai du moteur et de l'API, fournir des conseils techniques et une orientation tout en restant entièrement pratique - Concevoir, implémenter et maintenir des scripts de test automatisés basés sur Java pour les systèmes backend, en mettant fortement l'accent sur les tests API - Définir et développer la stratégie globale d'automatisation des essais, les cadres et les meilleures pratiques - Contribuer à tester la couverture automatique des systèmes frontaux au besoin - Traduire les exigences techniques et commerciales en scénarios d'essai efficaces et réutilisables - Exécuter des cas de tests automatisés, analyser les résultats et signaler les défauts en temps opportun et de façon détaillée - Enquêter et résoudre les défaillances et les problèmes pendant les essais - Assurer l'intégration transparente des essais automatisés dans les pipelines CI/CD - Coordonner les activités d'essai, prioriser les efforts d'essai et appuyer l'amélioration continue des processus d'essai - Définir et mettre en œuvre des normes de contrôle de la qualité et contribuer à des initiatives d'amélioration continue - Collaborer avec l'équipe de développement pour comprendre les flux de travail des applications et élaborer des stratégies de test complètes - Mentor et membres de l'équipe de soutien sur des sujets d'automatisation de test au besoin ## • Qualifications et compétences requises - Baccalauréat en informatique, génie informatique ou expérience équivalente - 5+ ans d'expérience pratique dans l'automatisation des tests backend, avec une expérience éprouvée dans les tests API - L'expérience antérieure d'un chef d'essai, d'un ingénieur principal d'automatisation des essais ou d'un rôle semblable est très appréciée - Expérience approfondie avec des outils tels que Postman, SoapUI, JMeter - Une bonne compréhension des API REST, y compris la conception des tests, l'automatisation, la validation et le dépannage - Expérience pratique avec SQL pour la vérification des données et la configuration de test - Connaissance des outils de CI/CD (p. ex. Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.) - Expérience avec Jira et Xray pour la gestion des tests - Excellente maîtrise de l'italien et de l'anglais (parlé et écrit) - La certification ISTQB ou similaire est un plus - Expérience pratique avec des outils comme Tosca Tricentis dans un plus - Bonne compréhension des méthodologies Agiles et de l'expérience de travail dans les équipes Scrum - Une forte appropriation, une attitude proactive et la volonté de contribuer activement aux activités d'essais quotidiens ## Besoin d'emplacement - Veuillez noter qu'une politique de travail totalement éloignée n'est pas proposée pour ce rôle - Les candidats devraient être prêts à se réinstaller dans le canton du Tessin/Suisse ou dans des villes proches de la frontière suisse-italienne - Les journées de travail à domicile peuvent être possibles selon la politique du client N'hésitez pas et appliquez maintenant! Notre recherche de personnel s'adresse aux candidats de tous les sexes. Les données seront traitées et stockées exclusivement aux fins de cette sélection ou de futures sélections, conformément à la loi fédérale sur la protection des données (LPD) et garantissant les droits visés à l'art. 13 Décret législatif 196/03 et règlement de l'UE 679/2016 (RGPD)
